cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned the calendar page like you. June settled. The hall said no, so we're meant to marry somewhere better.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I turned it because June's full. Every venue we asked is booked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, June dealt with. September gives us longer to practise being married.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My parents can't travel in September.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll go to them. Ask about their garden; we're finally finding where the wedding belongs.

reason: Tie mistaken imitation to the actual hopeful redirect, outward comfort, reciprocal-risk bargain, bounded vulnerability, or feared ending; keep material partner contributions and natural requests.
